source.author: verg
source.text: Invitent croceis halantes floribus horti et custos furum atque avium cum falce saligna Hellespontiaci servet tutela Priapi.
source.text_original: Invitent croceis halantes floribus horti / et custos furum atque avium cum falce saligna / Hellespontiaci servet tutela Priapi.
source.text_english: Let the gardens, breathing of saffron flowers, invite them, and let the guardian of thieves and birds, Hellespontian Priapus, with his willow sickle, keep watch as protector.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: demque poeta maximus, homo in cetens prudens, in hoc solo non poetice, sed aniliter desipit, in illis emendatissimis libris etiam fieri hoc iubet: et custos furum atque auium cum falce saligna Hellespontiaci seruet tutela Priapi.
reuse.text_original: demque poeta maximus, homo in cetens prudens, in hoc solo non poetice, sed aniliter desipit, in illis emendatissimis libris etiam fieri hoc iubet: et custos furum atque auium cum falce saligna Hellespontiaci seruet tutela Priapi.
reuse.text_english: And that greatest poet, a man prudent in other matters, is in this one respect not merely unpoetically but like an old woman foolish, for in those most polished books he even orders this to be done: and let the guardian of thieves and birds, Priapus, the protector of the Hellespont, be kept with a willow sickle.
